{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Confirm the unique sites
print("Unique sites:", trial_df['site'].unique())

# Check if there are four sites as implied by the question
site_count = trial_df['site'].nunique()

# Calculate response rate per site
response_rate_by_site = trial_df.groupby('site')['responded'].mean()

# Identify the site with the highest response rate
highest_site = response_rate_by_site.idxmax()
highest_rate = response_rate_by_site.max()

# Print results
print(f"Number of unique sites: {site_count}")
print(f"Response rates by site:\n{response_rate_by_site}")
print(f"Highest response rate: {highest_site} ({highest_rate:.3f})")"}
